chapter: Songwriting and the future of New Orleans music
title: Writing about family and everyday things with humor
summary: King explains that he writes about everyday situations, as Ray Charles did, and adds humor.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Song Right. And there are a lot of songs that you know where I'll describe families and neighborhoods and little places like Mother-in-law and neighbor's daughter and the mother's love, mama and papa. I was wondering if he thinks about family situations and things like that in the right song.

Yeah, a friend of mine that told me one time, when you write and if you really talk about the everyday things that really gone with yourself or people, you come up with a closeness to the audience and that was one of Ray Charles' key things years ago that he was on that level. And as my friend of mine, guitarist, that was his theme. He thought about writing about what went on with himself and you know, other people. But I tried to put humor in some of my writing, even though no matter how serious the theme of it may be, I may just inject a little humor in it for certain sort of reasons. I do this.
